title: l1qw.26.2a: COSE_Sign1 invitation envelope codec (encode/verify helpers + payload dataclass, unit-tested)
description: Smallest child of l1qw.26.2 (spec 18.8.2). Add the invitation COSE_Sign1 codec as a standalone, unit-tested module (group_membership.py or a sibling): protected header bstr-wrapped 47A1013A00010000 ({1:-65537} — cbor2-verified), unprotected kid = inviter 8-byte IID, payload CBOR map with integer keys 1-7 (group_id, group_name, mcast, role, expiry, invitee_iid, nonce), signature over SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)) with Schnorr48-Ed25519 (share the Sig_structure/protected-header helpers with lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py — make those two helpers public there instead of duplicating). Verify helpers: alg -65537 check, kid present, payload round-trip. NO resource wiring in this slice (groups_invite/collection adoption is .26.2b); unit tests cover encode->verify round-trip, tamper rejection (alg, kid, payload byte, signature), and the canonical protected-header bytes 47A1013A00010000.
close_reason: Re-close (store revert, recurring; work landed 80ece96798 verified in tree). COSE_Sign1 invitation codec, 10 tests, 3x reviewed with findings fixed in-round — see prior close reason.
